decisions.q: How is the app protected after the first sign-in?
decisions.rec: Approved 21 Nov 2026: App lock now (fingerprint, face or PIN, on by default). Passkeys later, once there's a real release key and a domain.

decisions.q: Recycled phone numbers: a new person could get an old number and see its records.
decisions.rec: Approved 21 Nov 2026: On a new device, also ask for a passkey or recovery code. If the account has neither and was inactive 90+ days, hide its records until support checks the person. Needs: confirm 90 days, and who does support. Support: a support email the owner creates later.
Approved 21 Nov 2026: Show one once after sign-up, stored only as a hash. It answers P2 and replaces a lost passkey.
Approved 21 Nov 2026: Block sign-up at launch with a calm message, until legal review settles the guardian path.

decisions.q: The old email and password routes?
decisions.rec: Approved 21 Nov 2026: Keep them until the app stops using them, then remove. All existing accounts are synthetic.

decisions.q: Which service sends the WhatsApp codes?
decisions.rec: Approved 21 Nov 2026: whichever is cheaper and easier to build, AWS End User Messaging Social or the Meta Cloud API. The backend compares them (task 6) and the lead records the pick.
Approved 21 Nov 2026: Not in Phase 5. Add it to Profile in Phase 6.
Mobile number plus a one-time code by WhatsApp only. No SMS or DLT for now.
Yes: Calm Glass UI v4, light and dark, Plus Jakarta Sans (Noto Sans Devanagari kept for Hindi).

decisions.q: Search and the bell in the header
Records, Medications and Profile aren't designed
decisions.rec: The designer does them after Medication Details; until then they keep their layouts on the new colours.
Locked. Missed only when the user says so; an untouched past dose shows Not confirmed.
No. Today may scroll; nothing overlaps or clips.
Ring and "N of M taken", counted from recorded Taken doses only. No percentage.
S01 to S03 in Phase 5, S04 and S05 in Phase 6. Allergies are stored in Phase 6 but drive no safety check until Phase 16.
